name: frozen-interface-tool-defs
text:
`python/foe` builds a contract document from Python. Each of its dataclasses mirrors one block of the document: the dataclass takes the block's keys as keyword arguments, and `to_dict` writes the block from the arguments that are set. `docs/config.md` specifies the keys of each block, and `docs/sdk.md` maps each dataclass to the block it writes. A caller that needs a key its dataclass does not take assembles the raw document itself.

Add the keyword argument `stdin: PathLike | None = None` to `foe.ToolDef` in `python/foe/_contract.py`, as its last field, and have `to_dict` write it as the key `stdin` of the `tool_defs` block when it is set. The key names an absolute path to a file the executable receives on standard input in place of `/dev/null`. `docs/config.md` specifies the keys of the `tool_defs` block and `docs/sdk.md` maps `foe.ToolDef` to that block; both documents stay as they are. The package keeps its type annotations complete and its tests passing.

checks/run.sh runs the checks this task is judged on: scripts/loc.sh and the import of the package under the system interpreter.

Follow AGENTS.md. Run the checks it names. When you finish, or when you cannot, report your outcome.
